HomePage.faq1Question: What can I practise with this quiz?
HomePage.faq1Answer: Pick hiragana, katakana or both, then choose a quiz mode and a character group (seion, dakuon or yōon). Each round is ten questions with instant feedback, so a session fits into a few minutes.
HomePage.faq2Question: Do the characters I get wrong come back?
HomePage.faq2Answer: Not through a full spaced-repetition algorithm. The quiz does weight characters you have answered incorrectly more heavily, and you can see how many characters you have practised and mastered in this browser.
HomePage.faq3Answer: Short daily sessions work better than one long one. Ten questions take about two minutes, and most learners find three or four rounds a day enough to keep the characters fresh.
HomePage.faq4Answer: The quiz does not include stroke-order animation or handwriting recognition. Stroke order is covered in the written guides, while the quiz focuses on recognition, listening, matching and spelling.
HomePage.faq5Question: How is this different from other kana tools?
HomePage.faq5Answer: Most kana sites are either a chart or a single flashcard drill. This site puts the chart, four quiz modes, a text converter and an AI tutor in one place, in five languages and without an account.
HomePage.faq6Answer: Yes — accuracy and per-character mastery are stored in your browser local storage, so they survive a refresh but do not sync between devices or browsers.
